content:
I’m not someone who really speaks here in this server much, I usually lurk, but I wanna comment as an Ogier fan who was and still is excited he’s getting a Genesis form, and has saved up enough to be going for +12 GOgier (and I even kinda like his new design, especially after getting a look at his sprite), I feel so weird on this kit after seeing it. It’s all over the place, and it kinda reflects the state of this game and direction BIAV seems to be going in.

They REALLY just went out of their way to gimp everything that could have made him stand out, and gave him restrictions to ‘balance’ him around other chars, like they legit went out of their way to make sure he he SPECIFICALLY won’t work with Thais, and probably Hameln too by making sure he can only get one stack of Undertow per turn, WHICH BY THE WAY, makes him worse by design since he has to hold off on using his Exalt. They legit refuse to let us use newer characters with old characters, or at least not without major restrictions, and that’s REALLY damn annoying and almost comes across as petty. Team building really is just getting worse and more restrictive and unfun as time goes on, and I truly suspect that it is just because they want to SO BAD make the Global server just ~~as bad as~~ like JP. But that’s neither here nor there.

His E2 is also just a ??? moment. Why is it for his strike and not his defense? It’s so useless. And his AA is really good, and yay for me since I have stocked up enough to probably get +12… but again it really does signal the direction the game is going. We were promised the game would not be balanced around AA/whales, and yet that’s certainly the direction they seem to be headed towards. I really just don’t get it, this kinda stuff is really just turning people off, and while I’m not a giga whale, I am a dolphin who +12s characters that I like, but I have no desire to spend anymore because it feels like I invested badly. Not even sure I’ll +12 GTulu, my favorite character.
